props.name: after
props.description: Shown after the text, at the end of the last visible line, only while the text is cut or expanded; it takes no room while the text fits. A function receives the state, for an expand control (`EllipsisToggle`).

props.name: children
props.description:
The text. Inline content only (text, links, code, mentions): a block child such as `

` or `

` breaks the clamp.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether the whole text shows at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: expandOnClick
props.description: Makes the cut text itself the button that expands it and collapses it again, for a keyboard and a touch screen as well as a pointer. Only plain text with no `after` takes it: a text with a link or another control inside stays text, and so does one with an `after`, whose control is the button instead (a button can't hold another).

props.name: lines
props.description: How many lines the text may take before it is cut.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: The tooltip shown on hover, and on keyboard focus when the text is a button, while the text is cut: `true` shows the children, a node shows that node, `false` shows none. It never opens on a text that fits, or on a touch screen.

name: EllipsisToggle
description: The control that expands an Ellipsis and collapses it again, for its `after`. A real button, with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` pointing at the text. The label is the caller's: "Show More" / "Show Less".

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
